# Beamer workflow attribution

Upstream: https://github.com/Noi1r/beamer-skill
Frozen reference: f3d62c07f775530eddb13d435b91a9a86e7c9049 (MIT; license retained here).

`apps/pi-web/lib/course-builder-pack.ts` contains a rewritten, compact adaptation
of the create / compile / review / polish / verify teaching workflow. This is not
a claim that the full upstream skill, all reference files or all scripts are vendored.
User templates and course constraints override stylistic defaults. Approval and
compiler capabilities are enforced by Pi Own code, not by upstream prose.
